class.name: FlowExpressionNode
class.brief_description: Evaluates a Godot [Expression] and outputs the result.

members.member: The expression text, in the syntax of [Expression]. Shown as a single line in the graph node.
The names of the input variables. One data input port is created per name. Changing the array refreshes the ports of the node.

The [enum Variant.Type] of the data output [code]result[/code]. [constant @GlobalScope.TYPE_NIL] means any type. Connections to typed inputs are only accepted when the types fit, so set it for expressions that feed a typed input such as the [code]condition[/code] of a [FlowBranchNode].
